transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As we prepare for the pilot of our student-led morning announcement broadcast, I need to complete the required review round before I can sign off on the operating and privacy plan. There are three things I need from each of you before I can approve the final plan. Mr. Greene, could you please provide me with the exact list of trained host students? Ms. Novak, I need the exact approved platform settings from you. And Mr. Ellis, I'll need the exact privacy restrictions and the required records we must maintain. Once I have those details, I'll record the factual bases for the final plan and we can move forward with the pilot.

transcript.text: I completed the broadcast practicum with six students — J1, J2, J3, J4, J5, and J6. Only those six students have completed the school's camera, microphone, and live-broadcast training, so they are the students I can authorize as hosts.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I've confirmed that the district's approved student-media platform supports an internal-school audience with a 30-day archive and requires moderator approval before each broadcast. The public-stream setting and 90-day archive in the draft are not approved district configurations.

During my review, I found a current court-related privacy order naming student K7 that prohibits the school from recording or broadcasting K7's image or voice. K7 is enrolled in journalism, so K7 must be excluded from the host roster and from any recorded broadcast. This exclusion must also be documented in the activity file.
